ety.text: Inherited from Old East Slavic тазъ (tazŭ), a Turkic borrowing. Compare Crimean Tatar tas, Turkish tas, Tatar тас (tas), etc. Ultimately from Persian تاس (tâs).
From Chinese 韃子 /鞑子 (dázi), originally meaning any foreign ethnic group in Northern China, from Chinese 韃靼 /鞑靼 (Dádá), from Old Turkic 𐱃𐱃𐰺 (t¹t¹r¹).
Humorous alteration of ВАЗ (VAZ), the main factory manufacturing Lada-brand automobiles, influenced by the noun таз (taz, “basin”) with the implied sense of “low-tech metal item” or “rustbucket”.
